record.question: Which of the following safety measures are necessary for using credit card?
options: Make online transactions only on secure, well established and reputed websites. Always ensure that the address of the website where transactions to be done, starts with 'https://'.
Change your card PIN (Personal Identification Number) periodically.
Avoid using cyber cafes for Internet Banking purpose
